scope: Replace repeated SAB signature candidate comparisons with a linear-time scan without changing candidate precedence or parse behavior.

changes.algorithm: Knuth-Morris-Pratt per signature and bit alignment; bounded prefix table is proportional to the fixed short signature, and input scanning is linear.
preservedPrecedence: lower bit alignment before higher alignment
earliest byte offset within each signature/alignment pair
generatedControls: ACIS stream selected over an earlier ASM signature marker
Existing 3-bit-shifted ACIS vertex projection remains covered
changes.resourceBehavior: No DWG/DXF wire format, parser budget, public API, or support disposition changed.
